name: Calacatta Oro Supremo
description: Rare Italian marble with bold gold veining. Ideal for feature walls, flooring, and high-end countertops.

name: Verde Alpi Classic
description: Dramatic alpine marble with rich forest green tones and white veining. A timeless luxury choice.

name: Black Marquina Elite
description: Iconic Spanish marble with high contrast white veining. Commands attention in any space.

name: Silver Travertine Vein Cut
description: Cross-cut travertine revealing natural vein patterns. Warm and organic — perfect for spa and residential settings.

name: Honey Onyx Backlit
description: Translucent onyx — spectacular when backlit. Transforms any surface into a glowing focal point.

name: Rosa Portogallo Deluxe
description: Elegant Portuguese marble with soft blush tones. Adds warmth and femininity to luxury interiors.

name: Absolute Black Granite
description: Indian absolute black granite. Zero visible grain — a bold statement for contemporary spaces.

name: Kashmir White Supreme
description: Sought-after Indian granite with dramatic wine and golden crystal inclusions on a white base.

name: Pietra Grey Limestone
description: Iranian limestone with fossil inclusions. Understated and architectural — a designer favourite.

name: Silver Fox Quartzite
description: Brazilian quartzite with dramatic movement. Hard-wearing and visually spectacular for flooring and statement walls.
